dimensions.question: Can a first-time researcher explain the current one-fragment workflow and its limits after twenty seconds?
Does each material capability claim point to the inspected source and state what it does not prove?
Can the reader distinguish untrusted source generation from JEV-only classifier judgments?
Do headings, link text, and short bold anchors communicate situation, mechanism, boundary, and next action?
Do both images explain the claim/evidence path without implying unsupported automation?
Can a maintainer resolve citations and reproduce offline checks from this revision?

decision_rule: Merge readiness requires the pinned CGM contract validator, target headings and required-reference/link checks, a current-source audit, the docs-manifest validator, and required repository CI to pass on a current branch. Separate reader/visual observations are optional QA, not an approval gate; do not claim unrecorded observations.
